info.title: Zweitstimme Forecast API
info.description:
Public JSON API for **election-day forecasts**, **posterior draws**, and **Aktuelle Stimmung**.

Static files, CORS-open (`Access-Control-Allow-Origin: *`), **GET only**. No authentication.

This is **not** the polling API for individual surveys. That lives at [api.zweitstimme.org/docs](https://api.zweitstimme.org/docs).

## Concepts

- **Forecast** — model output for election day: point estimates, uncertainty intervals, scenario probabilities, and optionally posterior draws.
- **Stimmung** — Kalman-smoothed latent support by calendar day. Days without a new poll are still present. No seat scenarios. The full series is ~10 years; prefer `/current.json`, `/day/{date}.json`, `/month/{YYYY-MM}.json`, or `/year/{YYYY}.json`.
- **`election`** — names the next relevant election for that scope. It is not the forecast timestamp. The same path can refer to a later cycle.

## Versioning

| Version | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `v1` | Legacy contract from when only federal forecasts existed. Kept for compatibility. |
| `v2` | Current contract: federal and state election-day forecasts (districts, candidates, parliament sims), posterior draws, and Stimmung. |
| unversioned `/forecast.json` etc. | Aliases of the `v1` federal files. |

Start at `GET /api/index.json`. Prefer `v2` for new integrations. Federal data exists under both `/api/v1/federal/` (old row shape) and `/api/v2/federal/` (metadata + `fit`/`low`/`high`, same as state).

## Envelope

Versioned endpoints wrap payloads as:

```json
{
  "api_version": "v2",
  "generated_at": "2026-08-18T08:06:53Z",
  "election": { "id": "st_2026-09-06", "name": "Landtagswahl Sachsen-Anhalt", "date": "2026-09-06", "scope": "state", "state_code": "ST" },
  "data": {}
}
```

## Availability

- State forecasts exist only inside the **~90-day window** before election day. Outside that window the path returns **404**.
- After election day the last forecast moves to `/api/v2/federal/archive/` or `/api/v2/state/archive/` (including districts / candidates / parliament sidecars when archived).
- Archives start when this API began publishing them; there is no historical backfill.
- Website `/data/*.json` files mirror the same pipeline outputs for the UI; prefer the versioned `/api/v2/` paths as the public contract.

## Units

Watch the unit. Party vote shares in summary forecasts are usually **percentage points**. Posterior draws use **shares from 0 to 1**. Federal `probabilities` / `pred_probabilities` are also 0–1. State scenario `probability` values are **percent 0–100**. District win probabilities and candidate `p_entry` / `p_direct` / `p_list` are **integer percents 0–100**.

## License

Texts, explanations, and visualizations: [CC BY 4.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/), attribution **zweitstimme.org**. Polling inputs may come from [dawum.de](https://dawum.de) ([ODbL](https://opendatacommons.org/licenses/odbl/)) and [wahlrecht.de](https://www.wahlrecht.de) / the named institutes. No guarantee of availability, completeness, or correctness. Forecasts and Stimmung are model outputs, not official results.

get.description: Alias of `/api/v1/federal/forecast.json`. Enveloped payload, not a bare array.
Alias of `/api/v1/federal/pred_probabilities.json`.
Alias of `/api/v1/federal/forecast_districts.json`.

Election.description: Which election this payload refers to. Re-read it; the same path can name a later cycle.

state_code.description: Uppercase state code, or null for federal payloads.

date_is_estimated.description: True when the election date is a placeholder, not a scheduled date.

generated_at.description: API publish time (UTC). Distinct from the model-run timestamp inside `data`.

as_of.description: Present on Stimmung responses: calendar day represented by the payload.

ApiIndex.description: Machine-readable catalog of the Forecast API.

FederalPartyRow.description: Legacy `v1` party row. `value`/`y` and interval fields are percentage points. `low`/`high` ≈ 83% interval; `low95`/`high95` ≈ 95%. Prefer `FederalPartyRowV2` on `/api/v2/federal/forecast.json`.

FederalPartyRowV2.description: Current federal party row. Same fields as state forecasts (`party`, `party_code`, `fit`, `low`, `high` in percentage points). `low`/`high` ≈ 83%; `low95`/`high95` ≈ 95% when present.

last_update.description: When this forecast was computed / exported.

FederalProbabilities.description: Probabilities as shares from **0 to 1**, not percentages. Keys: `hurdle_*` (clears 5%), `maj_*` (coalition seat majority), `prob_*_largest`, `grundmandat_*`.

FederalDistrictRow.description: District-level first/second-vote forecast row. Large file.

draws.description: Present when posterior draws are published.

districts.description: Present when Wahlkreis forecasts are published.

candidates.description: Present when candidate entry probabilities are published.

parliament.description: Present when parliament-size / seat sims are published.

probability.description: Percent from 0 to 100, not a 0–1 share.

last_poll_date.description: Newest poll included in this forecast.

last_update.description: When this forecast was computed / exported (UTC).

lead_horizon_days.description: Days until election used in the model.

StateDistrictRow.description: Landtag Wahlkreis × party row with candidate bio fields when available.

p_entry.description: Probability of entering parliament, integer percent 0–100.

p_list.description: Probability via list seat, integer percent 0–100.

StateCandidatesData.description: Candidate list/direct entry probabilities for one Land.

StateParliamentData.description: Parliament-size and per-party seat simulation for one Land (Hare/Niemeyer + district overhang/Ausgleich).

party_seats.description: Per-party seat distribution stats from the simulation.

StateDraw.description: One posterior simulation. Values are vote **shares from 0 to 1**, normalized to 1.

StateDrawsData.description: Self-contained posterior draws. Timing and model fields sit at `data` (no nested `metadata` object). `n_draws` / `unit` / `parties` come once, just above the raw `draws` array. Regenerated whenever the state forecast is rerun.

last_poll_date.description: Newest poll included in this forecast.

summary.description: Published point estimates and ~83% intervals in percentage points, computed from these draws.

forecast_path.description: Companion summary endpoint for this same run.

normalization.description: Each draw's party shares sum to 1.

unit.description: `share` means 0–1 vote shares, not percentage points.

parties.description: Map of party label → numeric value. Inactive parties may be null.

uncertainty_low.description: Map of party label → numeric value. Inactive parties may be null.

uncertainty_high.description: Map of party label → numeric value. Inactive parties may be null.

StimmungSeriesData.description: Daily series for a date range. `from`/`to` mark the inclusive window. The unfiltered file (`federal.json` / `{code}.json`) is the full ~10-year history. For a subset use `/month/{YYYY-MM}.json` or `/year/{YYYY}.json`.

from.description: First calendar day in this payload (inclusive).

to.description: Last calendar day in this payload (inclusive).

current.description: Latest day only; present on the full-series file.

trends.description: Map of party label → numeric value. Inactive parties may be null.
